page.overview:
Who is Aurornis?

is an extinct genus of anchiornithid theropod dinosaur that lived in China during the Late Jurassic period alongside Anchiornis and Xiaotingia. It was once classified as a troodontid before being put in the anchiornithid family in 2017.

A study from 2017 suggested that Aurornis may be a junior synonym of Anchiornis, as the two dinosaurs lived in the same area.

Aurornis is mentioned in the database entry for the Tiaojishan Formation, the dig site for Jeholopterus.
